description:
Hushfeed 0.50.0 keeps failed settings writes recoverable, keeps movable feed controls inside safe areas, and moves Feature Gate Lab ranking off TikTok's UI thread.

### What changed

* Large translated settings titles now keep words whole at enlarged text sizes.
* Movable feed controls stay clear of system bars, display cutouts and TikTok's bottom tab row.
* Feature Gate Lab precomputes searchable text and ranks nonempty searches on a cancellable worker.
* Failed settings writes restore the live value and preserve an unfinished migration source.
* Failed local feed actions now report the error instead of showing a false success or Undo action.
* Concurrent setting writes are serialized so an older failed write can't roll back a newer value.
* Settings restore rejects fractional and overflowing backup schema numbers.
* Session budget resets invalidate older queued writes.
* The guarded S22 tool now reads the focused app on display 0, targets input to display 0, recognizes wrapped Android 16 activity records and resolves Windows ADB paths under WSL.

### Compatibility and verification

This release targets the global TikTok 47.0.3 APK, version code 2024700030. All 91 patches apply without forcing compatibility or changing the manifest on 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3, 46.9.3 and 47.0.3.

The local gate passed 1,471 TikTok runtime tests, 243 patch tests and both Android lints. The exact bundle produced a 91-patch APK that was installed over the existing same-signer TikTok build on the S22 without clearing app data. The installed APK matched the candidate byte for byte, the original first-install time stayed intact, and the account stayed signed in. Hushfeed remains the first Settings and privacy row and reports version 0.50.0 for TikTok 47.0.3.

A second Samsung pass used an S25 Ultra running TikTok 47.0.3 with its existing Hushfeed 0.46.0 build. In dark theme, Hushfeed was first in Settings and privacy. The settings root, search, Back behavior and Feature Gate Lab worked. Its older hook report found 60 of 63 checked anchors, with two comments-sheet anchors and one story-viewer anchor missing. This is a useful older-build baseline, not exact 0.50.0 acceptance. The S25 installation uses a different Morphe Manager signing key, so the 0.50.0 test APK wasn't installed and no app data was removed.

Bundle SHA-256: `c98422ce65cc604263a13b311180c43e16e6b27af2519646f3c7da1da835d964`

### Open checks

Feature Gate Lab search is off the main thread, but the strict frame trace still recorded 8 of 15 app frames above 16.67 ms. Portrait feed-control safe areas passed. TikTok kept the tested feed activity in portrait when landscape was requested, so landscape coverage remains open.

Issue #16 was reported against Hushfeed 0.48.0 on a Galaxy A73. The exact 0.50.0 S22 candidate showed the seek bar, opened comments without sending, loaded Watch history and opened a history item. The reporter's device and account condition remain under investigation.
